FEEDBACK: Strengthen the calculation-method applicability selector: require nltl:calculationMethod values to be instances of nltl:calculationMethodValue (not merely arbitrary IRIs). The current sh:nodeKind-only constraint permits an untyped or unrelated IRI to bypass the nonlinear-method condition, creating an accidental non-applicability pass.

Remove the unconditional sh:minCount 1 calculationMethod requirement applied to every ship-linked calculation case; applicability must be determined solely by the nonlinearCalculationMethodValue selection, so unrelated or unclassified calculation cases do not fail. Add sh:class qudt:QuantityValue to both MillimetreQuantityShape and UnitlessQuantityShape so all quantity-property values satisfy their declared canonical range as well as numericValue and unit constraints.

Candidate faithfully targets ships, conditionally applies obligations to nonlinear calculation cases, preserves declared property owners and paths, requires the controlled nonlinear method value, evidence, margins, deformation operands, structural dimension, and a true explicit minor-deformation assessment, with correct quantity datatypes and units.
